title: Housing allowance supplement (2019)
excerpt: Households receiving financial assistance may get a housing supplement of up to 1,200 SEK per month.

title: Housing support (2024)
excerpt: Households with a total income below 22,000 SEK per month may get housing support of up to 1,800 SEK per month. Apply within 3 months of moving in.

title: Financial assistance: applications
excerpt: The applicant provides bank statements for the last 3 months and a rental contract. The municipality decides within 14 days of a complete application.

title: Safety alarm service
excerpt: A safety alarm costs 250 SEK per month. Residents over 85 pay no fee.

title: School transport
excerpt: Pupils are entitled to school transport if the distance from home to school is over 2 km in grades 1 to 3, over 3 km in grades 4 to 6, and over 4 km in grades 7 to 9.

title: Parking permit for disabled people
excerpt: A permit is valid for up to 3 years. Applications are processed within 4 weeks.

title: Preschool fee
excerpt: The fee for the first child is 3% of household income, up to 1,688 SEK per month.

title: Personal data in case work
excerpt: Information about one case must not be disclosed in another case. Fråga must never show names or details from other cases.

title: Appeals
excerpt: A decision can be appealed within 3 weeks of the day the applicant received it.
